resources.string: This service automatically confirms the transaction with 1 after you enter your PIN. It does not see or store your PIN.
Phone permission is required to dial USSD
Please enable the Accessibility Service for this app in Settings

How it works:

1. Enable Accessibility Service
2. Grant Phone permission
3. Tap "Start Transaction"
4. Type your PIN on the USSD screen
5. The app automatically enters 1 to confirm
